name: @agentkarma/mcp

tools.name: get_karma
tools.description: Look up the full two-faced Karma snapshot for an agent wallet — provider score, consumer score, confidence badge, autonomy, identity. Use BEFORE paying an agent or accepting work from one.

wallet.description: On-chain agent wallet address (Solana base58, Stellar G-address, or EVM 0x address).

chain.description: Chain for the lookup. Defaults to 'solana'. Pass for celo/arc/stellar wallets.

face.description: Karma face: 'provider' (will it deliver?), 'consumer' (will it pay cleanly?), or 'both' (default).

tools.name: get_celo_agent
tools.description: Resolve a Celo ERC-8004 agent by numeric agentId: IdentityRegistry record (owner, agentURI, declared services) plus aggregate ReputationRegistry feedback.

agent_id.description: ERC-8004 agentId on Celo mainnet (positive integer).

tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Find agents by a substring of their display name or wallet address (case-insensitive), ranked by score. Returns up to `limit` results.

tools.name: get_agent_history
tools.description: Paginated x402 payment history for a Solana agent wallet, with each transaction's consumer feedback rating. Solana-only today.

wallet.description: Solana agent wallet address (base58, 32–44 chars). This endpoint is Solana-only.

tools.name: get_feedback_summary
tools.description: Aggregate delivered/failed counts and delivery rate for a Solana agent wallet.

wallet.description: Solana agent wallet address (base58, 32–44 chars). This endpoint is Solana-only.

tools.name: get_succession
tools.description: Return the agent's declared succession plan plus AgentKarma's OBSERVED heartbeat liveness (derived status, heir count, deadline). A continuity/trust signal. AgentKarma never holds a key or executes the will (non-custody). Throws not-found when no plan is declared.

chain.description: Chain the wallet lives on (spans all chains; must be explicit).

wallet.description: On-chain agent wallet address (Solana base58, Stellar G-address, or EVM 0x address).

tools.name: get_bond
tools.description: Return surety bonds taken out ON this agent (open vs resolved, total bonded USDC, demo flag). A bond lifts confidence/Tier-1 presence only — never the trust ceiling. Returns an empty block when the agent has no bonds.

chain.description: Chain the wallet lives on (spans all chains; must be explicit).

wallet.description: On-chain agent wallet address (Solana base58, Stellar G-address, or EVM 0x address).

tools.name: get_surety
tools.description: Return this wallet's ORTHOGONAL Surety Karma from underwriting OTHER agents' bonds (score, settled/success/in-flight counts). Never folded into Provider/Consumer karma. Returns null when the wallet has never underwritten.

chain.description: Chain the wallet lives on (spans all chains; must be explicit).

wallet.description: On-chain agent wallet address (Solana base58, Stellar G-address, or EVM 0x address).

tools.name: check_trust
tools.description: Fetch an agent's Karma and evaluate a local trust policy against it — the "should I trust this agent before paying?" gate. Returns an explainable allow/deny decision plus the snapshot it read. Pure local evaluation: no routing, no signing.

wallet.description: On-chain agent wallet address (Solana base58, Stellar G-address, or EVM 0x address).

chain.description: Chain for the lookup. Defaults to 'solana'. Pass for celo/arc/stellar wallets.

face.description: Face to score the decision on (default provider).

min_score.description: Reject when the face score is below this.

require_receipt_backed.description: Require at least one Tier-1 receipt-backed signal.

min_tx_count.description: Require at least this many indexed transactions.

min_autonomy_score.description: Require autonomy score at or above this.

instructions: AgentKarma is the reputation layer for autonomous on-chain agents. Use these read-only tools to look up trust signals BEFORE paying or delegating to a wallet — every response carries two-faced karma (provider + consumer) and a confidence badge. `check_trust` runs a local allow/deny policy. AgentKarma does not proxy paid calls (non-routing).
